nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
## Use your own sheet

Load a reference sheet in **Reference sheet**, then describe the shot in **Prompt**, naming what is on the sheet. **Shorter side** sets the size, keeping the sheet's shape; **Seconds** and **Frame rate** set the length.

**Needs** ComfyUI 0.37 or newer (frontend 1.53 or newer) and ComfyUI-LTXVideo at commit 3bf3ca6 or newer. If any node shows up red, here or inside a subgraph, update ComfyUI or the LTXVideo pack rather than rewiring the graph.
